about: Sim joint angle -> motor command: motor_deg = zero_deg + sign * scale * sim_deg. sim_range_deg is the joint range in IK/motion2/arm/arm.xml (tests check it). AK45 commands also stay within zero_deg +- limit_deg (set to cover the sim range, 2026-11-05; it was 15 before); servo commands within 0..180. verified=false means the joint/motor pairing, sign and zero are still assumptions (2026-11-05).

joints.name: AK45_4
joints.note: widened from +-105 (model +-100) to +-135 on 2026-11-20 (user); forearm/upper-arm clearance at the ends not checked on the real arm.

joints.name: W_YAW
joints.note: sim wrist_pitch turns about the forearm (axis along it at sim 0, IK/motion2/arm/arm.xml; the CAD joint names are swapped), so it drives the servo named W_YAW. Swapped from W_PITCH on 2026-11-20 (user); the real servo's motion is not checked yet.

joints.name: W_PITCH
joints.note: sim wrist_yaw bends the wrist (axis parallel to the elbow's at sim 0), so it drives the servo named W_PITCH. Swapped from W_YAW on 2026-11-20 (user); not checked on the real arm yet.

joints.name: F_ROT
joints.note: fixed in the sim (hand_base_to_rotation_base = -pi, finger 3 facing fingers 1 and 2). Sim 0 here means that pose; zero_deg is the servo angle that gives it.
